description: Security profile for the cap-agent-ui5-webui sample
//: Without this, XSUAA rejects the approuter's login with 'the request for
authorization was invalid' - the redirect_uri it sends
(https://<router>/login/callback) is not whitelisted, so the OAuth flow
never starts. The failure looks like an IdP misconfiguration rather than a
missing entry here, which makes it easy to chase the wrong thing.
Narrow the wildcard to your own route if you prefer.
